authorization: Root delegated development-only mechanism diagnostic; execution requires detached source review.

protocol.comparisons: all three matched seed receipts, bounded and no-tanh; descriptive aligned mean curves only, no explained-gain ratio or new CI
protocol.eligibility: range(0,N-60,5), strict s+60<N; no reselection or exclusions
protocol.envelope: per-channel [min_patch(Z0)-1, max_patch(Z0)+1], broadcast to every target patch
protocol.floating_point: real-arithmetic relaxation anchored to the executed FP32-normalized initial features; not a certified machine-rounding bound
protocol.layout: channel-major 384 channels x 16 spatial patches; no coordinate mask
protocol.normalization: frozen training statistics cast to float32; anchor subtraction/division exactly as model FP32
protocol.persistence_check: all windows/all59 offsets reproduce frozen CPU persistence metric with rtol=2e-6,atol=2e-7
protocol.primary_aggregation: equal windows within trajectory, then equal eligible trajectories; each analytical envelope counted once, not once per seed
protocol.roundoff_screen: secondary sensitivity expands each endpoint by 32*eps32*(1+max(abs(Z0))+abs(mean/std)); not a rigorous roundoff theorem
protocol.scope: post-development exploratory analytical mechanism diagnostic; no causal attribution
protocol.target_coordinates: (raw_target-float32_mean)/float32_std in float64 to express real-valued raw-MSE/std^2
